courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「颱風風荷載與凹角平面」與「風洞試驗的相似律與資料換算」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Typhoon wind and the notched plan" and "Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Mega-column and outrigger structural systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦在填海地盤與颱風環境中，以核心筒、八根巨柱、四道外伸臂與摩擦型壁樁支撐 484 m 塔樓；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統則以外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on supporting a 484 m tower on reclaimed land in a typhoon climate with a core, eight mega-columns, four outrigger levels and friction barrettes; Mega-column and outrigger structural systems centres on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「凹角方形平面」與「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Notched square plan” and “Core rotation and column axial stiffness”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Mega-column and outrigger structural systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

以「巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。

Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Taipei 101, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 香港環球貿易廣場
history.text: 環球貿易廣場是西九龍九龍站上蓋發展「Union Square」的核心，2000 年 Kohn Pedersen Fox 贏得有限邀請競圖，Wong & Ouyang 為合作建築師，業主為新鴻基地產。結構概念由 Leslie E. Robertson 提出八根巨柱、核心筒與外伸臂的方案，Arup 在施工階段擔任結構工程並發展摩擦型壁樁基礎，該基礎形式在當時對香港相對較新。塔樓 2002 年動工、2010 年完工，頂部的麗思卡爾頓酒店於 2011 年 3 月開業，成為香港最高建築。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The International Commerce Centre is the centrepiece of the Union Square development above Kowloon Station in West Kowloon. Kohn Pedersen Fox won a limited international competition in 2000, with Wong & Ouyang as associate architect and Sun Hung Kai Properties as developer. Leslie E. Robertson proposed the structural concept of eight mega-columns, a core and outriggers, and Arup served as execution structural engineer and developed the friction barrette foundations, a system then relatively new to Hong Kong. Construction began in 2002 and was completed in 2010, and the Ritz-Carlton hotel at the top opened in March 2011, making it Hong Kong's tallest building. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
